prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated and well-established home care agencies serving Pleasanton, CA include Right at Home East Bay, Hillendale Home Care, and Always Best Care Senior Services. Always Best Care Senior Services +2
Phone: (925) 401-5261
Services: Companion care, personal care, Alzheimer’s/dementia care, Parkinson’s care, diabetes care, meal preparation, 24/7 care, and discharge-to-home support.
Accreditations & Highlights: Certified as a Great Place to Work, Home Care Pulse Certified, and partnered with the Aging Life Care Association and Parkinson's Foundation. They also offer RightAssist passive monitoring technology and monthly health reports.
Non-Medical vs. Home Health: Most agencies (like those above) handle non-medical daily living tasks (bathing, dressing, meal prep, and companionship). If your parent needs licensed medical treatment or physical therapy, look for a certified home health agency (such as Apollo Home Healthcare in Pleasanton or One Health Home Care nearby). A Place for Mom +3
Cost Expectations: In-home care in California typically ranges from $32 to $45+ per hour for licensed, bonded, and insured agency caregivers, with 24/7 or live-in care scaling higher depending on acuity and shift requirements. Loving Homecare
Vetting & Safety: Ensure the agency handles background checks, worker's compensation, general liability insurance, and bonded staff so you aren't legally acting as an employer. Visiting Angels +1
If you can share what specific types of help your parent needs (such as hourly companionship, 24/7 supervision, or memory care for dementia) and your preferred budget or schedule, I can help you narrow down the best fit.
